tests.title: Works with the example
tests.fail_how: Dos heaps: maxHeap con la mitad menor y minHeap con la mitad mayor. La mediana sale de sus cimas.
tests.fail_how_en: Two heaps: a maxHeap with the lower half and a minHeap with the upper half. The median comes from their tops.

tests.title: Works with a single element
tests.fail_how: Con un elemento, el heap izquierdo tiene 1 y el derecho 0: la mediana es la cima del izquierdo.
tests.fail_how_en: With one element, the left heap has 1 and the right has 0: the median is the top of the left one.

tests.title: Works with duplicates and no integer overflow
tests.fail_why: Falla con repetidos o desborda al sumar dos Integer grandes antes de dividir.
tests.fail_how: Convierte a double ANTES de sumar: (low.peek() + (double) high.peek()) / 2.0. int + int puede desbordar.
tests.fail_why_en: Fails with repeated values or overflows when adding two large Integers before dividing.
tests.fail_how_en: Convert to double BEFORE adding: (low.peek() + (double) high.peek()) / 2.0. int + int can overflow.

tests.title: record O(log n) / median O(1): 200,000 operations
tests.fail_why: Ordenar o insertar en una lista ordenada en cada record es O(n log n) o O(n) por operación.
tests.fail_how: Invariante: low.size() == high.size() o low.size() == high.size() + 1. record: ofrece a low, pasa su máximo a high, rebalancea. O(log n) por inserción y O(1) para la mediana.
tests.fail_why_en: Sorting or inserting into a sorted list on every record is O(n log n) or O(n) per operation.
tests.fail_how_en: Invariant: low.size() == high.size() or low.size() == high.size() + 1. record: offer to low, move its max to high, rebalance. O(log n) per insert and O(1) for the median.
